    <h2>{`About this task`}</h2>
    <p>{`You can include custom controls when adding attachments and link them to attachment attributes.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Prerequisites`}</h2>
    <p>{`This feature is only supported with the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`touch`}</inlineCode>{` theme. The attribute `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`allow-naming`}</inlineCode>{` must be set to true when declaring the attachment list in the application xml. The attributes with which you link custom controls can be persistent or non-persistent. They must be valid DOCLINK attributes and must be included in the object structure of the attachment datasource.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Procedure`}</h2>
    <p>{`The custom controls are added using the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`custom-options`}</inlineCode>{` slot on attachment lists. The slot supports controls of the following type: `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`text-input`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`number-input`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`checkbox`}</inlineCode>{` and `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`toggle`}</inlineCode>{`. You must define an `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`on-toggle`}</inlineCode>{` handler for `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`toggle`}</inlineCode>{` controls, or an `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`on-change`}</inlineCode>{` handler for the other supported controls. The name of the attribute is specified using `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`on-toggle-arg`}</inlineCode>{` for `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`toggle`}</inlineCode>{` controls, or `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`on-change-arg`}</inlineCode>{`.`}</p>
    <p>{`The controls will be displayed below the attachment description field, or below the folder list if that option was enabled.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Define one or more controls with the `}<inlineCode parentName="h3">{`custom-options`}</inlineCode>{` slot.`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<attachment-list id="attachmentList1" file-name-required="false" file-desc-required="false"
  datasource="attachmentds" show-folder-list="false" hide-when-empty="false" is-editable="true"
  show-managed-header="true" allow-naming="true"
  default-folder="CAD" record-marker-field-name="isdefault" record-marker-field-value="true"
  record-marker-icon="carbon:star--filled" check-deletable-item="checkDeletableItem"
>
  <checkbox slot="custom-options" label="Set as default" default-checked="true" checked="false"
    on-change="setAsDefault" on-change-arg="isdefault" id="ybm3n"
  />
  <toggle slot="custom-options" label="Analyse photo" toggle-label-off="No" toggle-label-on="Yes"
    type="TrueFalse" toggled="{page.state.analysePhoto}" on-toggle="setAnalysePhoto"
    on-toggle-arg="inferreq" id="bmyx8"
  />
  <number-input slot="custom-options" id="zaxve" label="Score" min="1" max="10" value="5" on-change="setScore"
    on-change-arg="score"
  />
  <text-input slot="custom-options" id="doctype1" label="Type" value="Images" on-change="setDocType"
    on-change-arg="doctype"
  />
</attachment-list>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Add event handlers for each custom control.`}</h3>
    <p>{`Two parameters are passed to each handler: the attribute name and the event emitted by the control. The event signature for `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`toggle`}</inlineCode>{` controls is `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`event.target.checked`}</inlineCode>{` (which will be true or false). The event signature for the other supported controls is `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`event.value`}</inlineCode>{`. Within the definition of the event handler you must call `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`event.onUpdate()`}</inlineCode>{` with two parameters: the attribute name and the attribute value. When the attachment is saved the payload will include the specified attribute and value.`}</p>
    <p>{`Below are sample event handlers for the custom controls defined in the previous attachment list declaration.`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`  /* checkbox */
  setAsDefault(attr, event) {
    log.i(TAG, 'setAsDefault: ', attr + '=' + event?.value);
    event.onUpdate(attr, event?.value);
  }

  /* toggle */
  setAnalysePhoto(attr, event) {
    log.i(TAG, 'setAnalysePhoto: ', attr + '=' + event?.target?.checked);
    this.page.state.analysePhoto = event?.target?.checked;
    event.onUpdate(attr, event?.target?.checked);
  }

  /* number input */
  setScore(attr, event) {
    log.i(TAG, 'setScore: ', attr + '=' + event?.value);
    event.onUpdate(attr, event?.value);
  }

  /* text input */
  setDocType(attr, event) {
    log.i(TAG, 'setDocType: ', attr + '=' + event?.value);
    event.onUpdate(attr, event?.value);
  }
`}</code></pre>
